task.name: Door-Hanging Safety Classifier
task.description: Binary image classification: is a passenger hanging on the door of a bus/leguna (unsafe) or not (safe)?
task.split: 70/15/15 stratified (train 269 / val 58 / test 58). NOTE: transfer models (ResNet50/ConvNeXt/EfficientNet) were retrained on train+val for deployment, so their val is not held out — see methodology_note.
task.primary_metric_note: Because data is imbalanced 2.9:1, watch UNSAFE-RECALL (catching violations), not just accuracy. A 'always safe' model already scores 74.5% accuracy while catching 0 violations.

human_level.definition: Careful expert reviewing the full-resolution image (can zoom). Used as the Bayes-error proxy.
human_level.why_not_zero: Labels themselves contain mistakes: IMG_3719 is an empty parked leguna annotated 'unsafe'; coco_export.json shows folder-vs-box conflicts (IMG_3873, IMG_4211) and one image with no safe/unsafe box; IMG_3484 and IMG_3774 carry BOTH 'safe' and 'unsafe' boxes (irreducible ambiguity). With label noise plus tiny/distant hangers (1-8% of the frame), neither human nor model can reach 0%.
human_level.sota: Controlled bus boarding/posture detection reaches 96-98% (MDPI Sensors 2026; MDPI Appl. Sci. 2025); real-world clutter drops naive systems to 72-75%; inter-annotator agreement for subjective safety labels is ~0.70-0.85 (Claru; PaSBench-Video). => clear images ~97-98%, borderline subset ~80-85%, blended ~96%.

error_analysis.summary: The 6-reviewer audit (misclassified_6sheets.xlsx) found a pool of 83 unique misclassified images across all 9 models; the Ensemble itself errs on only 11 (6 false-positive, 5 false-negative). The recall ceiling is set by ~3 structural cases almost every model fails (IMG_3484 two-door dual-box, IMG_3652 tiny side-door hanger, IMG_3774 distant double-decker dual-box) plus label noise. The biggest, cheapest win is fixing mislabelled images, NOT more modelling — AUC plateaus at ~0.93 across 6+ recall-improvement techniques (incl. box-crop localization, 0.929→0.932), the signature of a data ceiling.

per_model_counts._note: Manual 6-reviewer audit (misclassified_6sheets.xlsx): per-model errors on the 83-image union pool, split into false-positive (safe→unsafe) and false-negative (unsafe→safe, the safety-critical misses).

categories.ceiling: Recovers recall + raises the usable threshold

auc_progression._note: 5-fold CV ROC-AUC as recall-improvement techniques are stacked (paper Fig. 13 / RESULTS.md §4). AUC never clears the ~0.93 ceiling — the Ng 'plateau' signature that more modelling won't help; the binding constraint is data.

diagnosis.reasoning: Against the latest paper tables (held-out = 5-fold CV for the deep transfer models, held-out test for the rest), 8 of 9 models show large variance (+9% to +23%) and near-zero avoidable bias. The deep nets fit training ~0% but generalise at 8-14%; the classical HOG models OVERFIT too (SVM 1.9% train -> 20.7% test) - they do not underfit. Only the from-scratch CNN is balanced (train 7.8% ~= held-out 8.6%). Extra capacity does not help: AUC plateaus at ~0.93 across 6+ recall-improvement techniques (incl. box-crop localization) - the signature of a data ceiling, not underfitting. NOTE: deep-model headline numbers are 5-fold CV over the 327 train+val images (chosen because one test image moves the n=58 score ~6.7%); on the untouched test set the same models are lower - e.g. the Ensemble is 84.5% acc / 66.7% unsafe-recall there vs 91.7% / 80.7% on CV - so treat the CV figures as an optimistic-leaning estimate, not a held-out guarantee.
next_actions: Fix the ~11-13 mislabelled images (start with IMG_3719 + the 23 LABEL_AUDIT conflicts) - cheapest, highest leverage.
Collect more clear UNSAFE images (only 98 exist) - the main fix for a variance-limited model; targets safety-critical recall.
Keep current regularisation/augmentation (RandAugment, RandomErasing, weighted sampler, TTA); do NOT just scale up model size.
Deploy the high-recall operating point behind a human-review queue rather than chasing 100% recall.
diagnosis.note_classical_vs_deep: Measured: the classical HOG models OVERFIT (low train, high held-out), not underfit - so the whole model zoo is variance-limited, and more/cleaner data is the lever, not architecture.
